entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I bought a pair of your ridiculously expensive cycling shoes and they're complete garbage. I want my money back. Now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's under angrycustomer@email.com. And don't give me the runaround. These shoes have given me the worst blisters of my life. I can barely walk, let alone ride.

Okay, I've pulled up your account. I see the order for the Mountain Bike Shoes. I understand they're causing blisters, and I'm sorry for the discomfort. Just to be sure I'm on the right track, is there a specific technical fault with the shoe, or is it more of a fit and preference issue?

A fault? The fault is that they're terrible! Maybe the cleats don't align, maybe the material is cheap, I don't know and I don't care! I'm not a shoe engineer. I'm a customer who wants a refund for a defective product. Are you going to process this or do I need to speak to your manager?

I understand your frustration, and there's no need to speak to a manager; I can certainly handle this for you. I just need to confirm a few details. I see the order was delivered about 75 days ago. Let me just quickly check our return policy for you.
75 days, 80 days, who cares? Your website says 90 days. If you try to deny this, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. This is unacceptable.

No, you are absolutely correct. Our policy for standard items like these cycling shoes is indeed 90 days. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund. No problem at all.
Oh. Well... okay then. So you're actually going to process it?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file right now. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Okay. That's... good. So, a full refund, you said?
That's correct. A full refund for the item. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No. That was it. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
